rule_description: Income Certificate in Karnataka issued under Form No. 7/F is valid for five years from the date of issue. Must not be expired as on application date.
government_order_or_notification: Govt Order No. RD 187 LGP 2013 & RD 07 LGP 2015
relevant_clause: Clause 4(a) - Validity of Income Certificate extended to 5 years

rule_description: Annual household income stated in the certificate must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 for Categories 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B.
Caste Certificate must contain a valid 15-character Nadakacheri RD/GSC barcode number format (e.g. RD00382910293).
relevant_clause: Standard Atalji Janasnehi Kendra Barcode Protocol

rule_description: Applicant full name across Identity Document (Aadhaar), Caste Certificate, and Income Certificate must have high similarity (fuzzy ratio >= 85). Variations should prompt citizen verification before portal submission to avoid rejection at scholarship approval.
In compliance with Aadhaar Regulations and Privacy safeguards, only the last four digits of Aadhaar should be displayed or stored; the first eight digits must be masked.
government_order_or_notification: Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016 - Section 29

rule_description: SC/ST Caste Certificates issued in Form D / Form E in Karnataka are valid for lifetime unless revoked by the District Caste Verification Committee.
government_order_or_notification: Karnataka SC, ST and other BC (Reservation of Appointments, etc.) Act 1990 & Rules 1992
relevant_clause: Rule 3B - Lifetime Validity of SC/ST Certificates
